alerts.title: SQL injection pattern
alerts.description: A request URL matches a small set of SQL injection shapes (UNION SELECT, OR 1=1, information_schema, SLEEP, BENCHMARK, xp_cmdshell) after percent-decoding. At least one matching request returned a status below 400.
evidence: 203.0.113.70 - - [03/Nov/2026:15:03:48 +0000] "GET /index.php?id=1%20UNION%20SELECT%20username,password%20FROM%20users HTTP/1.1" 200 2600 "-" "sqlmap/1.8"
alerts.recommendation: Treat a status below 400 as a possible successful injection and escalate with the full URL. For 4xx or 5xx responses, block the source if it is not an approved test and review the application error log.

alerts.title: SSH brute force
alerts.description: Many failed SSH password attempts for one account from a single source address inside a short window. This is the usual shape of online password guessing against sshd. A successful authentication followed the failures.
evidence: Nov  3 11:00:00 lab-ssh sshd[7000]: Failed password for root from 203.0.113.50 port 40000 ssh2
Nov  3 11:00:20 lab-ssh sshd[7001]: Failed password for root from 203.0.113.50 port 40001 ssh2
Nov  3 11:00:40 lab-ssh sshd[7002]: Failed password for root from 203.0.113.50 port 40002 ssh2
Nov  3 11:01:00 lab-ssh sshd[7003]: Failed password for root from 203.0.113.50 port 40003 ssh2
Nov  3 11:06:00 lab-ssh sshd[3016]: Accepted password for root from 203.0.113.50 port 40016 ssh2
alerts.recommendation: Confirm the source is not a known scanner. If any attempt then succeeded, reset that credential, invalidate sessions, and escalate to Tier-2 with the raw lines attached.

alerts.title: Path traversal
alerts.description: A web request path or query contains a directory traversal sequence or a direct read of a sensitive Unix file. The URL is percent-decoded twice before matching. At least one matching request returned a status below 400.
alerts.recommendation: Capture the response status and body size. A status below 400 on a traversal URL is a possible file read: isolate the host and escalate to Tier-2. A 4xx can stay at high while you confirm the WAF or app rejected it.

alerts.title: Impossible travel
alerts.description: The same account authenticates successfully from two points that are too far apart for the time between them, faster than 900 km/h after a 500 km minimum. Lab cities come from the built-in TEST-NET map, not from a live GeoIP database.
evidence: Nov  3 14:08:00 lab-ssh sshd[6002]: Accepted publickey for alice from 198.51.100.30 port 43002 ssh2
Nov  3 14:22:00 lab-ssh sshd[6003]: Accepted password for alice from 203.0.113.80 port 43003 ssh2
alerts.recommendation: Ask the account owner whether they traveled or used a VPN. If they did not, reset the credential, revoke sessions, and review both source addresses.

alerts.title: Off-hours privileged logon
alerts.description: A privileged account (root, Administrator, an elevated Windows token, or Event ID 4672) authenticates successfully outside 08:00-18:00 UTC on a weekday, or at any time on Saturday or Sunday.
evidence: {"TimeCreated": "2026-11-03T02:17:00Z", "EventID": 4624, "Computer": "DC01", "TargetUserName": "Administrator", "IpAddress": "192.0.2.40", "LogonType": 10, "ElevatedToken": true}
alerts.recommendation: Match the logon to a change ticket or on-call rota. Interactive logons (SSH, or Windows logon type 10) without a ticket should be escalated, the credential rotated, and the source address reviewed.

alerts.title: Password spraying
alerts.description: One source address fails authentication against many accounts, with only a few tries each. Spraying stays under a per-account lockout and still tests a common password.
evidence: Nov  3 12:00:00 lab-ssh sshd[8000]: Failed password for invalid user svc01 from 203.0.113.60 port 41000 ssh2
Nov  3 12:00:30 lab-ssh sshd[8001]: Failed password for invalid user svc02 from 203.0.113.60 port 41001 ssh2
Nov  3 12:01:00 lab-ssh sshd[8002]: Failed password for invalid user svc03 from 203.0.113.60 port 41002 ssh2
Nov  3 12:01:30 lab-ssh sshd[8003]: Failed password for invalid user svc04 from 203.0.113.60 port 41003 ssh2
Nov  3 12:02:00 lab-ssh sshd[8004]: Failed password for invalid user svc05 from 203.0.113.60 port 41004 ssh2
alerts.recommendation: Compare the account list with a known jump box or vulnerability scanner. If the source is not approved, block it at the edge and reset any account that authenticated successfully from it afterward.

alerts.title: Anomalous src_ip behavior
alerts.description: IsolationForest fit on this batch marked the entity as an outlier. Dominant feature unique_paths=22.00. decision_function=-0.080. Review it next to any rule alerts for the same entity. Do not contain on this signal alone.
alerts.recommendation: Compare the entity with peer workstations or accounts from the same batch. Escalate only if a rule-based alert, a successful login, or an unusual geo corroborates the outlier.

alerts.title: Web scanning
alerts.description: One client requests many distinct paths and receives mostly client or server errors in a short window. Typical of vulnerability scanners walking a host.
alerts.recommendation: Check the user agent and whether the source is an approved scanner. If it is not, block the address and look for any probe that returned a status below 400.
